profile.summary: eccDNAMamba is a pretrained model for extrachromosomal circular DNA (eccDNA), circular DNA molecules that carry amplified oncogenes in cancer. It reads full-length eccDNA sequences of 10 to 200 kbp, and copies the start of each sequence onto its end so the model sees across the point where the circle was opened. Fine-tuned versions are used for cancer-associated eccDNA prediction, copy-number level estimation, and telling real from pseudo-eccDNA.
profile.summary_source_locator: arXiv abstract; model card: Model Overview; inference_sample.py circular_augmentation

summary_quotes.text: Extrachromosomal circular DNA (eccDNA) plays key regulatory roles and contributes to oncogene overexpression in cancer through high-copy amplification and long-range interactions.
it captures wrap-around dependencies in ultra-long (10–200 kbp) genomic sequences while maintaining linear-time scalability
"""Concatenate the first `extend_len` bases to form a circularly augmented sequence"""
The model provides strong performance across cancer-associated eccDNA prediction, copy-number level estimation, and real vs. pseudo-eccDNA discrimination tasks.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: eccDNAMamba is a bidirectional state-space model: forward and reverse Mamba-2 encoders read the sequence in both directions, with cost linear in sequence length. DNA is tokenised by motif-level byte pair encoding (BPE) with a vocabulary of 4096. To respect the circular shape, a head-tail augmentation appends the first 64 tokens after the end of the sequence. The pretrained backbone is a masked language model (BiMambaForMaskedLM) with 24 layers and d_model 768. For classification, the published fine-tuning code mean-pools the hidden states and adds a two-layer classifier head.
sections.source_locator: Model card: Model Overview; arXiv abstract; config.json; inference_sample.py

quotes.text: By combining **forward and reverse Mamba-2 encoders**, **motif-level Byte Pair Encoding (BPE)**, and a lightweight **head–tail circular augmentation**
It combines forward and reverse passes for full-context representation learning with linear-time complexity, and preserves circular structure through a novel augmentation strategy.

sections.title: Versions and reproducibility
sections.body: The pretrained backbone is eccDNAMamba/eccDNAMamba-1M (read at revision 36d95a3f). Seven fine-tuned checkpoints are published under the same organisation: cancer eccDNA prediction (short and ultra-long), copy-number level prediction (thresholds 10 and 4.5) and real against pseudo-eccDNA for Arabidopsis thaliana, Gallus gallus and Homo sapiens. The fine-tuned ultra-long checkpoint names eccDNAMamba-1M as its base model. A result should name the checkpoint and its revision. The repository also has a pretraining entry point (main.py).

facts.label: Model type
facts.value: Bidirectional state-space encoder pretrained as a masked language model on eccDNA sequences, then fine-tuned for classification.

quotes.text: the first bidirectional state-space encoder tailored for circular DNA sequences

facts.label: Architecture
facts.value: Two Mamba-2 backbones, one reading the sequence forward and one reading it reversed; their hidden states are concatenated and projected. The loading code takes n_layer (24) and d_model (768) from the configuration. The same config.json also lists num_hidden_layers 64 and hidden_size 4096, which the loading code does not use for the backbone size when n_layer is present.
facts.source_locator: Model card: Model Overview; config.json; modeling_BiMambaForMaskedLM.py

facts.label: Inputs
facts.value: eccDNA nucleotide sequences, tokenised by motif-level BPE (vocabulary 4096), with the first 64 tokens appended to the end for circular augmentation. The inference example keeps sequences of 10,000 to 200,000 bases.

facts.label: Outputs
facts.value: Masked-token logits from the pretrained model; class logits and probabilities from the fine-tuned models. The inference example also computes integrated-gradient token attributions.

quotes.text: # Access logits or reconstruct masked spans

facts.label: Parameters
facts.value: eccDNAMamba-1M: 537,420,672. Fine-tuned ultra-long cancer classifier: 538,012,802. Counted by Hugging Face from the published safetensors files.

facts.label: Training data
facts.value: The pretraining scripts take eccDNA coordinates from eccDNA Atlas (human, chicken, mouse) and CircleBase (human) and extract the sequences from the hg19, galGal4 and mm10 reference genomes; the download script also fetches hg38.

limitations.text: Needs a CUDA setup: the install compiles mamba_ssm and causal_conv1d with nvcc, and the inference example runs in bf16.

The setup instructions are inconsistent: the heading says PyTorch 2.1.0 with CUDA 11.8, the command installs torch 2.2.0+cu121, and requirements.txt pins torch==2.1.2. The model card's quick start uses the repository name eccdna/eccDNAMamba-1M, not eccDNAMamba/eccDNAMamba-1M.

run_guide.summary: Set up the eccDNAMamba environment at a pinned commit and run the minimal inference script, which classifies five ultra-long eccDNA sequences as cancer or not with a fine-tuned checkpoint.
prerequisites: conda and an NVIDIA CUDA setup: the README installs torch 2.2.0+cu121 and cuda-nvcc 12.1.105 to build mamba_ssm and causal_conv1d. GPU type and memory are not stated.
Weights and datasets are Apache-2.0 and not gated; the code has no stated licence.

steps.title: Get the code at the pinned commit
steps.shell:
git clone https://github.com/zzq1zh/eccDNAMamba.git
cd eccDNAMamba
git checkout --detach 3af9d76c8f9d8a7b7826807f06f80eeb0acb5deb
steps.explanation: The README does not give a clone command; these lines are added to get the repository at the commit this page was written from. The inference script imports BiMambaForMaskedLM.py and ig.py from the repository root.

steps.title: Create the environment
steps.shell:
conda create -n eccDNAMamba python=3.9
conda activate eccDNAMamba
steps.explanation: Creates and activates the Python 3.9 conda environment.

steps.title: Install PyTorch and nvcc
steps.shell:
pip install torch==2.2.0+cu121 torchvision==0.17.0 torchaudio==2.2.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
conda install -c "nvidia/label/cuda-12.1.105" cuda-nvcc
steps.explanation: Installs the CUDA 12.1 build of PyTorch and the CUDA compiler needed to build the Mamba kernels.

quotes.text: pip install torch==2.2.0+cu121 torchvision==0.17.0 torchaudio==2.2.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121

steps.title: Install dependencies
steps.shell:
pip install -r requirements.txt --no-deps
pip install datasets numpy==1.26.3 pyfaidx==0.8.1.3 mamba_ssm==2.2.4 causal_conv1d==1.5.0.post8 --no-cache-dir --no-build-isolation
steps.explanation: Installs the pinned requirements, then builds mamba_ssm and causal_conv1d against the installed PyTorch. Note that requirements.txt pins torch==2.1.2, which may replace the PyTorch installed in the previous step.

quotes.text: pip install datasets numpy==1.26.3 pyfaidx==0.8.1.3 mamba_ssm==2.2.4 causal_conv1d==1.5.0.post8 --no-cache-dir --no-build-isolation

steps.title: Run inference
steps.explanation: Downloads the fine-tuned checkpoint eccDNAMamba/eccDNAMamba_1M_cancer_eccdna_prediction_ultra_long and the dataset eccDNAMamba/cancer_eccdna_prediction_ultra_long, predicts five held-out sequences of 10 to 200 kbp, and runs an integrated-gradients attribution on one of them. Edit FINETUNED_PATH and DATASET_NAME for other tasks, as the README says.

quotes.text: Replace the fine-tuned model and corresponding dataset in the script below to handle different tasks.

outputs: One printed line per evaluated sequence with the true label, predicted label and class probabilities, then the integrated-gradients margin and a token-level attribution heatmap. Trainer working files go to ./inference_output.
limitations: These commands were read from the repository and have not been executed by Rewire.
The PyTorch versions in the README heading, the install command and requirements.txt disagree; the environment may need adjusting.
The script uses bf16 and the Mamba CUDA kernels, so a CPU-only machine is not expected to work; the sources do not state GPU requirements.

notes: The arXiv abstract links github.com/zzq1zh/GenAI-Lab, while the README and Hugging Face organisation point to zzq1zh/eccDNAMamba; the latter was used. The model card's quick start names eccdna/eccDNAMamba-1M, which returned HTTP 401 from the Hugging Face API; the published repository is eccDNAMamba/eccDNAMamba-1M. GENEB lists eccDNAMamba at 537M, consistent with the safetensors count. A later preprint by an overlapping author group (From Circles to Signals, DOI 10.1101/2025.11.22.689941) also describes eccDNAMamba; it was not read.
